verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a native SSH/Mosh terminal client that connects directly to user-specified hosts using SSH keys, tunnels, and ProxyCommand—no vendor relay/proxy/VPN is involved in the connection path (docs-1, docs-11, docs-12, docs-14, docs-15, docs-21). Community testimonials corroborate solid, direct connectivity in real use (comm-3, comm-4, comm-5).
